taxonomic_note: POWO accepts Vernonia baldwinii and recognizes infraspecific variation; Texas plants align with the broad-leaved western ironweed concept.
look_here_first: Tall robust ironweed with broader rough leaves and broad terminal arrays of purple discoid heads. Leaves are much broader than in V. lindheimeri.

project_inclusion.range_basis: Travis and Kerr are exact target-zone records. Williamson is documented but outside the project target-county list and is not counted.

approval_exception.reason: Correct stale PASS while preserving learner admission.

best_field_traits: broad ovate to lance-ovate rough leaves
broad flattened to irregular terminal arrays
purple discoid heads with no rays
morphology_keys.comparison_training: V. lindheimeri is much narrower-leaved with strongly revolute margins and densely woolly lower surfaces.

comparisons.key_distinctions: Broad leaves favor V. baldwinii; intermediate plants may be hybrid and should not be forced to a parent.
